name: Call of Earth
label: Quest
description: At Kodo Rock, you seek communion with earth through a sacred tauren rite. Drinking an Earth Sapta lets you see a Minor Manifestation of Earth.

clips.title: The story
paras: At Kodo Rock, you seek communion with earth through a sacred tauren rite. Drinking an Earth Sapta lets you see a Minor Manifestation of Earth.

Shamanic elders brew a sapta to bind an initiate’s mortal spirit to a primal element. Ancestral magic guards the brewing secrets, known to only a select few among the tauren. Drink the draught at a sacred site, and your mind opens beyond the physical world. The veil parts, and the elements can be witnessed in their raw form.

East of Camp Narache, Kodo Rock rises as a stone pillar and holy sanctuary. Drink the sapta there, and a Minor Manifestation of Earth appears before you. Along the shaman’s path, other aspects of nature are volatile, fiery, or raging. Earth asks for quiet humility instead. Honor the land, and its spirit grants you the mountain’s enduring strength and the plains’ calm patience.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the open minded to see the elements as no one has seen them before. Your spirit will forever be tied to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few of our kind know the secrets of its creation.
The sapta is always imbibed in a holy place, and never anywhere else.
Seek out the shaman shrine to the east of here and drink of the sapta.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah... Friend... Pleased is the earth to have you here.
Bound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.

Standing before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. But the others are not as passive. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.
